headline: Real estate: sales rush ahead of 15% tax – what changes from 2027 | News
summary: Buyers in Greece are rushing into property sales ahead of changes to sales taxation, including a 15% rate, which take effect from 2027. The changes are expected to affect buyer behaviour.
why: Real estate is a major asset class and a significant part of Greece's economy, so changes to property transaction taxes can shift demand, prices and transaction volumes for banks, developers and listed property firms.
